name: Hepta qualified full gates

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - codex/hia-rust-record-normalization-20261030
      - codex/hia-core-rust-convergence-20261030
      - codex/hia-core-closure-20261028
      - codex/hia-round6-convergence-20261029
      - codex/hia-round7-opportunity-20261029
      - codex/hia-round8-integration-20261029
      - feat/hepta-p0-p1-verified-ir-20261024
      - feat/hepta-agent-safe-cfg-cpp-20261024
      - feat/hepta-safe-migration-agent-20261024
      - dot/hepta-p0-p1-semantic-bridge-20261025
      - dot/hepta-p0-p7-integration-20261025
      - codex/hepta-p4-p6-guardrails-20261025
      - assistant/hepta-p0-p7-semantic-budget-20261025
      - implement/hia-unified-native-20261026
      - codex/hia-ndu-verified-optimization-20261027
      - codex/hia-ndu-bounded-pipeline-20261027
      - codex/hia-contract-integration-20261027
      - codex/hia-v8-blocker-convergence-20261027
      - audit/hepta-v7-static-budget-assertions-20261028
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - codex/hia-p0-p7-convergence-20261027
      - codex/hia-ndu-verified-optimization-20261027
      - codex/hia-ndu-bounded-pipeline-20261027
      - codex/hia-contract-integration-20261027
  workflow_dispatch:

# Qualify the PR head, not GitHub's synthetic merge commit. Different source
# versions retain independent runs even when they share a branch or PR.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release-qualification:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # The existing full profile retains all three regression passes. The explicit
    # round6/round7/round8 profiles run one integrated pass plus the canonical matrix.
    # This job watchdog does not change individual proof/search or zero-skip gates.
    timeout-minutes: 240
    env:
      HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HEPTA_SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
      HEPTA_RUN_ARTIFACT_SESSION: '1'
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      RUSTC: ${{ github.workspace }}/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/rustc
    steps:
      - name: Configure isolated Cargo directories
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          hepta_cargo_home="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-cargo-home"
          hepta_cargo_target="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-cargo-target"
          mkdir -p "$hepta_cargo_home" "$hepta_cargo_target"
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s\nCARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s\n' \
            "$hepta_cargo_home" "$hepta_cargo_target" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Checkout frozen source snapshot
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA }}
      - name: Record and verify the tested source head
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          actual_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          case "$HEPTA_SOURCE_BRANCH" in
            codex/hia-round6-convergence-20261029|codex/hia-round7-opportunity-20261029|codex/hia-round8-integration-20261029) hepta_qualification_profile=integrated ;;
            *) hepta_qualification_profile=full ;;
          esac
          mkdir -p artifacts
          printf '{"schema":"hepta.workflow-source.v1","expected_head_sha":"%s","checkout_head_sha":"%s","event_sha":"%s","qualification_profile":"%s"}\n' \
            "$HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA" "$actual_head" "$GITHUB_SHA" "$hepta_qualification_profile" > artifacts/workflow-source.json
          test "$actual_head" = "$HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA"
          printf 'HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_PROFILE=%s\n' "$hepta_qualification_profile" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Verification archive and pinned SMT dependencies
        run: python -m pip install zstandard z3-solver==4.15.4.0
      - name: Native compilers and required namespace runtime
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap apparmor-profiles gcc g++ curl gnupg gdb libboost-dev qemu-system-arm qemu-user
      - name: Load the distribution Bubblewrap namespace profile
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Keep the host-wide userns restriction and all Hepta isolation
          # checks. Ubuntu ships this profile separately from bubblewrap.
          hepta_profile=/usr/share/apparmor/extra-profiles/bwrap-userns-restrict
          test -f "$hepta_profile"
          hepta_userns_policy=/proc/sys/kernel/apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns
          hepta_policy_before=not_present
          if test -f "$hepta_userns_policy"; then
            hepta_policy_before=$(cat "$hepta_userns_policy")
          fi
          sudo apparmor_parser -r "$hepta_profile"
          sha256sum "$hepta_profile" > artifacts/bwrap-profile.sha256
          hepta_policy_after=not_present
          if test -f "$hepta_userns_policy"; then
            hepta_policy_after=$(cat "$hepta_userns_policy")
          fi
          test "$hepta_policy_before" = "$hepta_policy_after"
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          from experiments.agent_eval.sandbox import probe_sandbox
          report = probe_sandbox()
          Path("artifacts/sandbox-startup.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
          assert report["available"], report
          PY
      - name: Install the explicit LLVM 20 resource backend toolchain
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Ubuntu 24.04 runner images ship Clang 18 by default. The owned
          # LLVM profile requires 20+, and every native receipt hashes the
          # actual selected compiler. Use LLVM's signed versioned repository.
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-llvm.asc" \
            https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key
          hepta_llvm_fingerprint=$(gpg --show-keys --with-colons "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-llvm.asc" | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" { print $10; exit }')
          test "$hepta_llvm_fingerprint" = 6084F3CF814B57C1CF12EFD515CF4D18AF4F7421
          sudo install -m 0644 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-llvm.asc" /usr/share/keyrings/hepta-llvm.asc
          printf '%s\n' 'deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/hepta-llvm.asc] https://apt.llvm.org/noble/ llvm-toolchain-noble-20 main' \
            | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/hepta-llvm20.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes clang-20 libclang-20-dev libclang-rt-20-dev llvm-20 lld-20
          test -x /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang
          test -x /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang++
          test -x /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/llvm-readobj
          printf '%s\n' /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang --version
      - name: Install SHA-256-locked Rust 1.90.0 toolchain and cross stdlibs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python tools/bootstrap_toolchain.py
          hepta_rustc=$(realpath "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/rustc")
          test -x "$hepta_rustc"
          printf 'RUSTC=%s\n' "$hepta_rustc" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf '%s\n' "$(dirname "$hepta_rustc")" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Verify the actual selected compiler identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          from hepta.backend import find_rustc, toolchain_info
          selected = find_rustc()
          assert selected == str(Path(os.environ["RUSTC"]).resolve())
          report = toolchain_info(selected)
          Path("artifacts/selected-rustc.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
          PY
      - name: Install the separate finite graph Rust profile
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal
          printf 'FINITE_NDU_RUSTC=%s\nFINITE_NDU_CARGO=%s\n' \
            "$(rustup which --toolchain 1.95.0 rustc)" \
            "$(rustup which --toolchain 1.95.0 cargo)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          # The main compiler and recursive profile remain the pinned 1.90.0.
      - name: Fetch the locked Rust shadow dependencies before offline qualification
        shell: bash
        run: |
          hepta_cargo="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/cargo"
          test -x "$hepta_cargo"
          "$hepta_cargo" --version
          "$hepta_cargo" fetch --locked --manifest-path rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.toml
      - name: Build the original pinned NDU evaluator in an isolated workspace
        shell: bash
        run: |
          hepta_ndu_checkout="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-ndu-source"
          hepta_ndu_build="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-ndu-build"
          hepta_ndu_commit=$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("rust/hia-ndu-bridge/upstream.json"))["commit"])')
          git init "$hepta_ndu_checkout"
          git -C "$hepta_ndu_checkout" remote add origin https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci.git
          git -C "$hepta_ndu_checkout" config remote.origin.promisor true
          git -C "$hepta_ndu_checkout" config remote.origin.partialclonefilter blob:none
          git -C "$hepta_ndu_checkout" -c protocol.version=2 fetch --filter=blob:none --depth=1 origin "$hepta_ndu_commit"
          test "$(git -C "$hepta_ndu_checkout" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$hepta_ndu_commit"
          CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-ndu-target" python tools/build_hia_ndu_bridge.py \
            --upstream "$hepta_ndu_checkout" --output "$hepta_ndu_build" \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-ndu-build.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-ndu-build.stderr.log"
          printf 'HEPTA_NDU_BRIDGE=%s\nHEPTA_NDU_BUILD=%s\nHEPTA_NDU_UPSTREAM=%s\n' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-ndu-target/debug/hia-ndu-bridge" "$hepta_ndu_build" "$hepta_ndu_checkout" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Build the separately pinned recursive NDU bridge
        shell: bash
        run: |
          hepta_recursive_checkout="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-recursive-ndu-source"
          hepta_recursive_build="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-recursive-ndu-build"
          hepta_recursive_commit=2590c0c94c5bf9a9004caeeb7b75edd6faf3eb8b
          git init "$hepta_recursive_checkout"
          git -C "$hepta_recursive_checkout" remote add origin https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci.git
          git -C "$hepta_recursive_checkout" config remote.origin.promisor true
          git -C "$hepta_recursive_checkout" config remote.origin.partialclonefilter blob:none
          git -C "$hepta_recursive_checkout" -c protocol.version=2 fetch --filter=blob:none --depth=1 origin "$hepta_recursive_commit"
          git -C "$hepta_recursive_checkout" sparse-checkout set --no-cone \
            /codex-rs/Cargo.toml /codex-rs/hepta-ndu/ /codex-rs/hepta-types/ \
            /codex-rs/hepta-contracts/ /tools/hia-ndu-bridge/
          git -C "$hepta_recursive_checkout" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
          test "$(git -C "$hepta_recursive_checkout" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$hepta_recursive_commit"
          CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=0 python tools/build_hia_recursive_ndu_bridge.py \
            --ndu-source "$hepta_recursive_checkout" --expected-source "$hepta_recursive_commit" \
            --cargo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/cargo" --rustc "$RUSTC" \
            --output "$hepta_recursive_build" --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-recursive-ndu-target"
          printf 'HEPTA_RECURSIVE_NDU_BRIDGE=%s\nHEPTA_RECURSIVE_NDU_IDENTITY=%s\n' \
            "$hepta_recursive_build/native/hepta-hia-ndu-bridge" "$hepta_recursive_build/identity.json" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Build the independent finite graph evaluator
        shell: bash
        run: |
          hepta_finite_checkout="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-finite-ndu-source"
          hepta_finite_build="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-finite-ndu-build"
          hepta_finite_commit=4b6391e116949af0c7e59776baead67271856bdb
          git init "$hepta_finite_checkout"
          git -C "$hepta_finite_checkout" remote add origin https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci.git
          git -C "$hepta_finite_checkout" config remote.origin.promisor true
          git -C "$hepta_finite_checkout" config remote.origin.partialclonefilter blob:none
          git -C "$hepta_finite_checkout" -c protocol.version=2 fetch --filter=blob:none --depth=1 origin "$hepta_finite_commit"
          git -C "$hepta_finite_checkout" sparse-checkout set --no-cone \
            /codex-rs/Cargo.toml /codex-rs/hepta-ndu/ /codex-rs/hepta-types/ \
            /codex-rs/hepta-contracts/ /tools/hia-ndu-bridge/
          git -C "$hepta_finite_checkout" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
          test "$(git -C "$hepta_finite_checkout" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$hepta_finite_commit"
          CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=0 python tools/build_hia_recursive_ndu_bridge.py \
            --ndu-source "$hepta_finite_checkout" --expected-source "$hepta_finite_commit" \
            --cargo "$FINITE_NDU_CARGO" --rustc "$FINITE_NDU_RUSTC" \
            --output "$hepta_finite_build" --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-finite-ndu-target"
          printf 'HEPTA_FINITE_NDU_BRIDGE=%s\nHEPTA_FINITE_NDU_IDENTITY=%s\n' \
            "$hepta_finite_build/native/hepta-hia-ndu-bridge" "$hepta_finite_build/identity.json" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Build the separately pinned persistent stream NDU bridge
        shell: bash
        run: |
          hepta_stream_checkout="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-stream-ndu-source"
          hepta_stream_build="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-stream-ndu-build"
          hepta_stream_commit=c4a1bbed3a39beba43a6abf1a18b6f75c5725c21
          git init "$hepta_stream_checkout"
          git -C "$hepta_stream_checkout" remote add origin https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci.git
          git -C "$hepta_stream_checkout" config remote.origin.promisor true
          git -C "$hepta_stream_checkout" config remote.origin.partialclonefilter blob:none
          git -C "$hepta_stream_checkout" -c protocol.version=2 fetch --filter=blob:none --depth=1 origin "$hepta_stream_commit"
          git -C "$hepta_stream_checkout" sparse-checkout set --no-cone \
            /codex-rs/Cargo.toml /codex-rs/hepta-ndu/ /codex-rs/hepta-types/ \
            /codex-rs/hepta-contracts/ /tools/hia-ndu-bridge/
          git -C "$hepta_stream_checkout" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
          test "$(git -C "$hepta_stream_checkout" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$hepta_stream_commit"
          CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=0 python tools/build_hia_recursive_ndu_bridge.py \
            --ndu-source "$hepta_stream_checkout" --expected-source "$hepta_stream_commit" \
            --cargo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/cargo" --rustc "$RUSTC" \
            --output "$hepta_stream_build" --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-stream-ndu-target"
          printf 'HEPTA_NDU_STREAM_BRIDGE=%s\nHEPTA_NDU_STREAM_IDENTITY=%s\n' \
            "$hepta_stream_build/native/hepta-hia-ndu-bridge" "$hepta_stream_build/identity.json" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install SHA-256-locked Lean and QEMU tools
        run: python tools/bootstrap_verification.py
      - name: Export verification tools for every qualification step
        shell: bash
        run: |
          hepta_lean="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/lean-4.19.0/bin/lean"
          hepta_qemu="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/qemu-8.2.2/qemu-aarch64-static"
          hepta_linker="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rust-lld"
          test -x "$hepta_lean"
          test -x "$hepta_qemu"
          test -x "$hepta_linker"
          hepta_gate_tools="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-qualification-bin"
          mkdir -p "$hepta_gate_tools"
          ln -s "$hepta_qemu" "$hepta_gate_tools/qemu-aarch64"
          ln -s "$hepta_linker" "$hepta_gate_tools/ld.lld"
          printf 'LEAN=%s\nCLANG=%s\nHEPTA_CLANG=%s\nCLANGXX=%s\nCC=%s\n' "$hepta_lean" /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang++ /usr/bin/gcc >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'HEPTA_LLD=%s\nHEPTA_LLVM_READOBJ=%s\nHEPTA_QEMU_AARCH64=%s\nHEPTA_QEMU_RISCV64=%s\n' \
            "$hepta_linker" /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/llvm-readobj "$hepta_qemu" /usr/bin/qemu-riscv64 >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          # Full discovery builds the actual Rust oracle. Keep those generated
          # files outside the source inventory; source drift must still fail.
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-cargo-target" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf '%s\n' "$hepta_gate_tools" "$(dirname "$hepta_lean")" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Run all current native and experiment qualification gates
        if: ${{ success() && env.HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_PROFILE == 'full' }}
        run: >-
          python tools/release_check.py
          --output-directory artifacts/candidate
          --continue-on-failure
          --unit-timeout-seconds 3600
      - name: Qualify the standalone HIA interpreter and direct native paths
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && env.HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_PROFILE == 'full' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          export LEAN="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/lean-4.19.0/bin/lean"
          python tools/qualify_hia_unified.py \
            --output-directory artifacts/hia-unified \
            --lean "$LEAN" \
            --clang /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang \
            --cc /usr/bin/gcc \
            --rustc "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/rustc" \
            --cargo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/cargo" \
            --linker "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rust-lld" \
            --qemu-aarch64 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/qemu-8.2.2/qemu-aarch64-static" \
            --qemu-riscv64 /usr/bin/qemu-riscv64 \
            --qemu-system-arm /usr/bin/qemu-system-arm \
            --cxx /usr/bin/g++ \
            --unit-timeout-seconds 3600
      - name: Qualify proof-gated NDU and finite background/native mechanisms
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && env.HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_PROFILE == 'full' }}
        run: >-
          python tools/qualify_hia_ndu_pipeline.py
          --output-directory artifacts/hia-ndu
          --clang /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang
          --bridge "$HEPTA_NDU_BRIDGE"
          --bridge-build-receipt "$HEPTA_NDU_BUILD/build-receipt.json"
          --upstream "$HEPTA_NDU_UPSTREAM"
      - name: Qualify all eight integrated gates from a clean exact source
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Earlier gates retain reports in their checkout. Use the same exact
          # commit in a clean sibling so those observations cannot become input
          # drift or be discarded. The sibling keeps the installed toolchain paths.
          hepta_integrated_source="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../hepta-integrated-source"
          git --no-replace-objects worktree add --detach \
            "$hepta_integrated_source" "$HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA" \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-integrated-worktree.log" 2>&1
          test "$(git --no-replace-objects -C "$hepta_integrated_source" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA"
          test -z "$(git --no-replace-objects -C "$hepta_integrated_source" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
          cd "$hepta_integrated_source"
          # Locked dependencies were fetched into the isolated CARGO_HOME above.
          # The qualifier executes Cargo offline and reuses only this external cache.
          python tools/qualify_hia_integrated.py \
            --output-directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-integrated" \
            --expected-head "$HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA" \
            --clang /usr/lib/llvm-20/bin/clang \
            --cargo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/cargo" \
            --cargo-target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-cargo-target" \
            --rustc "$RUSTC" \
            --ranking-bridge "$HEPTA_NDU_BRIDGE" \
            --ranking-build-receipt "$HEPTA_NDU_BUILD/build-receipt.json" \
            --ranking-upstream "$HEPTA_NDU_UPSTREAM" \
            --recursive-bridge "$HEPTA_RECURSIVE_NDU_BRIDGE" \
            --recursive-identity "$HEPTA_RECURSIVE_NDU_IDENTITY" \
            --recursive-upstream "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-recursive-ndu-source" \
            --finite-bridge "$HEPTA_FINITE_NDU_BRIDGE" \
            --finite-identity "$HEPTA_FINITE_NDU_IDENTITY" \
            --finite-upstream "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-finite-ndu-source" \
            --stream-bridge "$HEPTA_NDU_STREAM_BRIDGE" \
            --stream-identity "$HEPTA_NDU_STREAM_IDENTITY" \
            --stream-upstream "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-stream-ndu-source" \
            --finite-cargo "$FINITE_NDU_CARGO" \
            --finite-rustc "$FINITE_NDU_RUSTC" \
            --timeout 3600 \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-integrated.log"
      - name: Execute the canonical safety matrix from the exact integrated source
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && env.HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_PROFILE == 'integrated' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/../hepta-integrated-source"
          test "$(git --no-replace-objects rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA"
          test -z "$(git --no-replace-objects status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
          python tools/qualify_hia_safety_contract.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-integrated-safety.json" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-integrated-safety.log"
      - name: Preserve failures and all raw evidence
        if: ${{ always() && env.HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_PROFILE != 'integrated' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hepta-release-evidence-${{ env.HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA }}
          path: |
            artifacts/
            evidence/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-ndu-build/build-receipt.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-ndu-target/debug/hia-ndu-bridge
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-ndu-build.stdout.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-ndu-build.stderr.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-recursive-ndu-build/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-finite-ndu-build/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-stream-ndu-build/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-integrated/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-integrated.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-integrated-worktree.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Preserve integrated observations and source identities
        if: ${{ always() && env.HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_PROFILE == 'integrated' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hepta-integrated-evidence-${{ env.HEPTA_QUALIFICATION_HEAD_SHA }}
          path: |

def _command(argv, timeout=1800):

def unittest_outcome(stderr, returncode):
    """Retain failed-run counts without accepting partial or skipped runs."""
    match = re.search(
        r"(?m)^Ran ([0-9]+) tests? in [0-9.]+s\s+"
        r"(OK|FAILED)(?: \(([^\n]*)\))?\s*\Z", stderr)
    result = {"tests_run": None, "skipped": None, "failures": None,
              "errors": None, "passed": False}
    if match is None:
        return result
    result.update(tests_run=int(match.group(1)), skipped=0, failures=0, errors=0)
    details = match.group(3)
    if details:
        for item in details.split(", "):
            field = re.fullmatch(r"(skipped|failures|errors)=([0-9]+)", item)
            if field is None:
                # Expected/unexpected successes or a changed summary format
                # require an explicit policy before the aggregate can pass.
                return result
            result[field.group(1)] = int(field.group(2))
    result["passed"] = (returncode == 0 and match.group(2) == "OK"
                        and result["tests_run"] > 0
                        and result["skipped"] == 0
                        and result["failures"] == 0
                        and result["errors"] == 0)
    return result


def cargo_test_outcome(stdout, returncode):
    """Count actual lib/bin/doc test results; an empty or ignored run fails."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(
        r"(?m)^test result: (ok|FAILED)\. ([0-9]+) passed; ([0-9]+) failed; "
        r"([0-9]+) ignored; ([0-9]+) measured; ([0-9]+) filtered out; "
        r"finished in [0-9.]+s\s*$", stdout))
    result = {"tests_run": None, "skipped": None, "failures": None,
              "filtered_out": None, "measured": None, "test_binaries": len(matches),
              "passed": False}
    if not matches:
        return result
    passed, failed, ignored, measured, filtered = (
        sum(int(match.group(index)) for match in matches) for index in range(2, 7))
    result.update(tests_run=passed + failed, skipped=ignored, failures=failed,
                  filtered_out=filtered, measured=measured)
    result["passed"] = (returncode == 0 and passed > 0 and
                        failed == ignored == measured == filtered == 0 and
                        all(match.group(1) == "ok" for match in matches) and
                        not stdout[matches[-1].end():].strip())
    return result

        raise ValueError("output directory must be new")

    write_new(output / "plan.json", (json.dumps({"git_commit": report["git_commit"],
        "source_snapshot_sha256": before["sha256"],
        "commands": [{"name": name, "argv": list(map(str, argv))} for name, argv, _ in plan]},
        indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode())

                timeout = unit_timeout_seconds if name == "unit_regression" else 1800
                executed = _command(argv, timeout=timeout)
                row = {k: v for k, v in executed.items() if k not in {"stdout", "stderr"}}
                row["name"], row["passed"] = name, False
                row["timeout_seconds"] = timeout
                for channel in ("stdout", "stderr"):
                    raw = executed[channel].encode()
                    logfile = output / (name + "." + channel + ".log")
                    write_new(logfile, raw)
                    row[channel] = {"path": str(logfile.relative_to(output)), "sha256": sha(raw), "bytes": len(raw)}
                if name == "rust_shadow_cargo":
                    row.update(cargo_test_outcome(executed["stdout"], executed["returncode"]))
                elif evidence is None:
                    row.update(unittest_outcome(executed["stderr"], executed["returncode"]))
                elif evidence.is_file() and not evidence.is_symlink():
                    try:
                        raw, _ = _read_regular_evidence(evidence)
                        payload = json.loads(raw)
                        if type(payload) is not dict:
                            raise ValueError("gate evidence must be a JSON object")
                        row["evidence"] = {"path": str(evidence.relative_to(output)), "sha256": sha(raw),
                                           "status": payload.get("status"), "ok": payload.get("ok")}
                        if name == "partial_record_resources":
                            from tools.hia_semantic_gate_receipts import validate_partial_records
                            validate_partial_records(payload, evidence.parent)
                            scoped_ok = True
                        elif name == "cpp_constexpr_migration":
                            from tools.qualify_cpp_constexpr import validate_cpp_constexpr_receipt
                            validate_cpp_constexpr_receipt(payload)
                            scoped_ok = payload.get("ok") is True
                        elif name in IMPORTED_QUALIFICATION_NAMES:
                            # Existing producers have different success fields.
                            # Their shared validator owns that convention and
                            # the complete nested evidence requirements.
                            require_collected_qualification(IMPORTED_QUALIFICATION_NAMES[name], payload)
                            scoped_ok = True
                        else:
                            scoped_ok = payload.get("ok") is True or (name == "legacy_cortex_m4_qemu" and payload.get("status") == "passed")
                        row["passed"] = executed["returncode"] == 0 and scoped_ok
                    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
                        row["evidence_error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}
                report["gates"].append(row)
                print(json.dumps({"gate": name, "passed": row["passed"], "seconds": row["seconds"],
                                  "returncode": row["returncode"]}), flush=True)
    finally:
        os.chdir(previous_cwd)
        for name, value in old_environment.items():
            if value is None:
                os.environ.pop(name, None)
            else:
                os.environ[name] = value
    report["source_snapshot_after"] = snapshot()
    report["unchanged_source"] = before == report["source_snapshot_after"]
    report["completed_gates"] = len(report["gates"])
    report["passed_gates"] = sum(row["passed"] for row in report["gates"])
    report["ok"] = report["unchanged_source"] and report["completed_gates"] == len(plan) and all(row["passed"] for row in report["gates"])
    report["status"] = "all_scoped_gates_passed" if report["ok"] else "scoped_gates_not_all_qualified"
    report["finished_utc"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
    write_new(output / "qualification.json", (json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode())
    return report


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output-directory", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--clang", default=shutil.which("clang") or "clang")
    parser.add_argument("--cc", default=shutil.which("gcc") or "gcc")
    parser.add_argument("--rustc", default=os.environ.get("RUSTC") or shutil.which("rustc") or "rustc")
    parser.add_argument("--cargo", default=os.environ.get("CARGO") or shutil.which("cargo") or "cargo")
    parser.add_argument("--qemu-aarch64", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--qemu-riscv64", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--qemu-system-arm", default=shutil.which("qemu-system-arm") or "qemu-system-arm")
    parser.add_argument("--linker", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--lean", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cxx", default=shutil.which("g++") or "g++")
    parser.add_argument("--unit-timeout-seconds", type=int, default=1800,
                        help="full unit regression timeout, in 1..3600 seconds")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not 1 <= args.unit_timeout_seconds <= 3600:
        parser.error("--unit-timeout-seconds must be in 1..3600")
    result = qualify(args.output_directory, clang=args.clang, cc=args.cc, rustc=args.rustc, cargo=args.cargo,
                     qemu_aarch64=args.qemu_aarch64, qemu_riscv64=args.qemu_riscv64,
                     qemu_system_arm=args.qemu_system_arm, linker=args.linker, lean=args.lean,
                     cxx=args.cxx, unit_timeout_seconds=args.unit_timeout_seconds)
    print(json.dumps({key: result[key] for key in ("ok", "status", "passed_gates", "completed_gates", "unchanged_source", "full_seven_deliverables_complete")}))
    return 0 if result["ok"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
